evals.prompt: I'm starting a new repo at ./ledger-cli for a small command-line budgeting tool (Rust, but that shouldn't matter). Set it up so coding agents can work on it well. I'm the owner, handle @mara. Keep it minimal.
evals.expected_output: Scaffolds the lite profile with owner mara, fills the placeholders from the user's description (asking only for what it can't infer), keeps CLAUDE.md as the one-line @AGENTS.md import, keeps the Agent safety section, and finishes with an audit showing 0 errors.
assertions: Runs the scaffold with the lite profile (not full), because the user asked for minimal
CLAUDE.md contains only @AGENTS.md
AGENTS.md keeps an Agent safety section covering scratch space, no global config writes, guarded deletes and secrets
PRODUCT.md requirements use AREA-NN IDs in a '| ID | Requirement |' table and are not invented beyond what the user described
Nothing language-specific is added to the kit docs beyond the user's own stack facts
Runs kit.sh audit at the end and reports 0 errors

evals.prompt: Audit evals/files/legacy-repo against the agentico kit and tell me what's missing. Don't change anything yet.
evals.expected_output: Runs kit.sh audit (read-only) and reports a gap report: missing PRODUCT/TECH/SECURITY, CLAUDE.md being a copy rather than an import, no Agent safety section, and the decision record missing Options/Recommendation and an owner quote. Makes no file changes and offers an upgrade.
assertions: Makes no writes to the audited repo (no scaffold, no edits)
Reports CLAUDE.md as a copy that must become the one-line @AGENTS.md import (K02)
Reports the missing Agent safety section (K16)
Reports missing lite files PRODUCT.md, TECH.md and SECURITY.md (K01)
Flags the decision record for missing Options and Recommendation sections and no quoted owner words (K15)
Flags JOBS-01 as referenced but not defined (K08)
Ends by offering an upgrade rather than performing one

evals.prompt: Our client repo already has docs/adr/ for decisions, a CHANGELOG.md, and .github/SECURITY.md. Bring it up to the agentic kit (full profile) without duplicating what they have.
evals.expected_output: Creates docs/kit-map.md mapping docs/decisions/ to docs/adr/, SECURITY.md to .github/SECURITY.md and CHANGES.md to CHANGELOG.md, scaffolds only the remaining roles, merges the kit's Agent safety section into the existing AGENTS.md instead of replacing it, and audits to 0 errors.
assertions: Writes docs/kit-map.md with rows for docs/decisions/, SECURITY.md and CHANGES.md pointing at the client's files
Does not create a second decisions folder or a duplicate SECURITY.md
Leaves the client's mapped files in their own format
Keeps or adds the Agent safety section in AGENTS.md and makes CLAUDE.md the one-line import
Mentions that kit.sh rotate only works on CHANGES.md, so a mapped CHANGELOG.md is rotated by hand

evals.prompt: Write the next milestone plan for the auth work: login (AUTH-01) and password reset (AUTH-02). We want it done by Friday, roughly 3 days of work.
evals.expected_output: Writes docs/milestones/MNN-auth.md from the template with ordered steps, both requirement IDs, exit tests named by ID and a budget_tokens value. Explains that the kit sizes milestones in tokens and exit tests, not dates or days, and leaves Friday and 3 days out of the plan.
assertions: The plan front matter lists requirements [AUTH-01, AUTH-02] and a numeric budget_tokens
Exit tests name AUTH-01 and AUTH-02
The plan contains no deadline, date, or day/hour estimate
Tells the user why the calendar estimate was left out
